scope: Personal numerical-label DAVIS calibration exercise; not an approved biological benchmark
baseline: DT03 fixed paired Morgan + frozen ESM-2 XGBoost model, four existing splits
labels: Reuse study_rule_label: supplied Kd <= 100 nM; supplied Kd = 10000 nM excluded by DT03
selection: One preselected calibration method; no model or method selection on test metrics
objective: Unweighted binary log loss on valid
optimizer: scipy minimize_scalar bounded over log(T), xatol 1e-10
ece: Positive-class ECE and top-label confidence ECE recorded separately
binRule: Equal-width bins over [0,1], left inclusive/right exclusive except final bin includes 1; empty bins omitted from sum
limitations: Single existing split assignment; conditional labels; very small cold-both valid set; no formal OOD or individual guarantee
